signature.name: One Lead Mover
signature.description: At any moment exactly one primary mover carries 'working on it' and every other moving element is visibly quieter, on a nested tempo, close to the lead, at both 120px and splash size.

lesson: Strong loaders pick one mover on one clock and make everything else breathe under it; weak ones add a second rhythm, a counter or an accumulating fill that the waiting eye has to track or that reads as a reset.

bare-wire.signature_why: The scar is the single lead, opening twice per 5s in nearly the same spot; the 5s bloom and the 2.5s glint lift are nested and quiet, though the glint sits off at the rim.
bare-wire.loved: Open fast, hold, close slowly over 1.7s: the hole settles instead of rippling, and it all stays in six fills-only shapes.
bare-wire.docked: At 120px a dark disc in a top-down cup still says 'something in a cup' more than 'coffee on its way', and the 0.3s opening is a little abrupt.
bare-wire.fix_note: They took the cap (.55, not .45) and a softer scar colour with a sound contrast reason, but kept two drops per loop; at 2.5s that is calm enough, so I accept the call.

warm-hands.signature_why: The turning spiral is clearly the lead; the stream is static and lands on its pivot, the bloom breathes on the same 5s clock, and making the rim stain static removed the one far-off secondary.
warm-hands.loved: The stream turns 'a spiral that spins' into 'a spiral being poured' at no cost to the seamless linear sweep.
warm-hands.docked: The spiral is still the biggest shape and still rotates, so a spinner read survives at 120px, and animated SVG groups behind <use> still repaint.
warm-hands.fix_note: The stream was built exactly as specified, outside .sweep, opacity-only; the stain went to 3.6 not 4 but is now static and reads as one ring.

the-glitch.signature_why: The drop now leads on one vertical axis, but the crema steps swing opacity .10 to .80 (as much contrast as the lead) and drain back in 0.25s, a hitch that pulls the eye every loop.
the-glitch.loved: Removing the orange layer and the hard cuts leaves the most literal and calm coffee read on the table: a drop falls, squashes and rings into the cup.
the-glitch.docked: The accumulating crema climbs to near-full at 4.7s and then empties: a fill-and-reset that the team's own screenshots confirm, and the 1Hz beat is still brisk.
the-glitch.fix_note: The pips, slip and ghost are gone, but they put a new count in their place that resets every loop, the very thing the note asked them to remove; the 'provocation' reason does not hold for a waiting user.
